old_gate: failed observations remain unchanged in prior report
required_dependency: ortools 9.15.6755 enabled, pytest >=9,<10; record actual versions before workers
fresh_rule: include every reconstructable Regular-only source; retain exclusions; no outcome replacement

lanes.trajectory: capture complete native final portfolio immediately before P3; run actual opt-in within its original 5s deadline; replay baseline portfolio through actual Application finalization; compare final winner with same trajectory
lanes.fixed_work: frozen native portfolio; exact same existing helper, <=24 native packs and <=64 source pieces; infinite cooperative deadline but worker timeout; replay twice and require identical geometry/rank and counts; not a 5s production claim
lanes.runtime: separate fresh-process off/on observations, order reversed; report total wall, CPU, native search, snapshot projection and measured P3 tail; calibrated statistics do not erase old max-delta failures

criteria.safety: all views complete, source identities, physical Kerf, allowed transforms and actual JS/strict import
criteria.quality: no board or final-rank regression versus captured same-trajectory native portfolio in any actual operational worker
criteria.efficacy: repeatable gains in >=2 known cases and >=1 newly frozen independent case for default-activation recommendation
criteria.fixed_work: A/A replay exact rank/material equality; exact bounded packing count; classify timeout separately
criteria.incremental_tail: every measured P3 tail <=0.50 sec; same absolute threshold measured directly rather than as independent-run noise; no claim old gate passed
criteria.runtime: median fresh-process enabled/disabled wall ratio <=1.10; retain every individual gap; no hard 5s response guarantee
criteria.activation: no activation unless all operational safety/quality/efficacy/tail gates pass; fixed-work-only gains do not suffice
